work: Go to the lowest floor of your building now: the basement or ground floor.
Get into an interior hallway, stairwell or restroom with no windows.
Stay away from the lobby's glass doors and windows.
Crouch down and cover your head and neck with your arms.
home: Go to the basement. If there is none, use an interior room on the lowest floor (closet or bathroom).
Put as many walls as possible between you and the outside.
Cover your head; a mattress or heavy blankets help.

phases.label: Warning issued
phases.action: Shelter where you are now. Don't drive.
phases.alertText: The National Weather Service issued a Tornado Warning at 7:15 PM for central Washtenaw County, including Ann Arbor and Pittsfield Twp, until 8:45 PM. Radar shows a storm with rotation 11 miles southwest of downtown Ann Arbor, moving northeast at 35 mph. Expected arrival near downtown around 8:00 PM. Hazards: tornado, damaging winds up to 70 mph, heavy rain 1–2 inches per hour. Ypsilanti is in a Severe Thunderstorm Warning, not the tornado warning.

timeline.text: Tornado Warning issued for Ann Arbor & Pittsfield Twp, until 8:45 PM.

phases.alertText: The Tornado Warning for Ann Arbor and Pittsfield Twp continues until 8:45 PM. At 8:00 PM, radar shows the rotating storm 1.5 miles west of downtown Ann Arbor, moving northeast at 35 mph. A funnel cloud was reported near Pioneer High School at 7:58 PM. It is expected to leave the Ann Arbor area by 8:30 PM.

appGuide: Bottom tabs on every screen: Home, Map, Check-In, Ask/Help (this chat), More.
The colored banner at the top of every screen shows the alert level and when it ends. Tap it for the full official alert.
Every claim has a small source chip (✓ for official, ? for community reports). Tap it to see who reported it and when. More → Sources lists every source.
Home → 'What this means for you' cards (Power, Water, Roads, Shelter) open details for Home, Work and Mom's house.
Home → Updates shows the timeline of changes, newest last, color-coded by urgency.
Shelter card → shows what to do in your building now, nearby public places with power and water, and a route button.
Map tab → choose one layer at the top (Radar, Roads, Power, Shelters). The legend at the bottom explains every symbol.

Check-In tab → tap 'I'm safe' or 'I need help', then confirm. Your status and who it was sent to stay at the top of the page. 'Request check-in' asks someone for their status; '+ Add person' sends an invite link (they don't need the app).
More → Forecast at My Places shows hourly rain and wind for Home, Work and Mom's house. More → My Places lets you add or edit places.
More → Neighbor Reports shows posts from people nearby with time and distance; you can post what you see.
